purpose: Fifteen public event hubs used to find current event calendars and event-submission routes across Colfax, Las Animas, and Huerfano counties.
review_policy: Automation may report page changes and candidate event links. A person must review dates, locations, costs, submission rules, and public wording before canonical event data changes.
selection_note: Five high-value public event hubs are maintained for each county. The set favors local government, tourism, libraries, local media, MainStreet or creative-district organizations, and public submission routes.

sources.name: Explore Raton Events
sources.public_use: Visitor-facing events, festivals, attractions, and activities in and around Raton.
sources.action: Check the current event page and follow its event links for dates and organizer details.

sources.name: Raton MainStreet Events
sources.public_use: Downtown Raton events, community activities, markets, and MainStreet programs.
sources.action: Use the event page for current downtown dates and organizer links.

sources.name: KRTN Area Events
sources.public_use: Public events, school activities, meetings, arts, sports, and community announcements across the Raton area.
sources.action: Review the area-events calendar and use KRTN's current contact route for listing questions.

sources.name: The Ratonian Community Calendar
sources.public_use: Raton-area community events and a public route for proposing a calendar listing.
sources.action: Open the calendar to review current events or use its submission form.

sources.name: Visit Angel Fire - List Your Event
sources.public_use: Visitor-facing events in Angel Fire and the Moreno Valley area.
sources.action: Use the current tourism submission form; inclusion remains at the publisher's discretion.

sources.name: Visit Trinidad - Submit Your Event
sources.public_use: Visitor-facing events, activities, performances, and community happenings in Trinidad.
sources.action: Use the tourism submission form and allow time for editorial review before the event date.

sources.name: Trinidad Carnegie Public Library Events
sources.public_use: Library programs, classes, youth and family activities, meetings, and public learning events.
sources.action: Check the calendar for current library-hosted programs and registration details.

sources.name: CREATE Trinidad Events
sources.public_use: Exhibitions, performances, workshops, creative-business events, and cultural activities in Trinidad.
sources.action: Use the creative-district event page for current arts and culture dates and organizer information.

sources.name: Main Street LIVE Events
sources.public_use: Theater, music, performance, and ticketed cultural events in Trinidad.
sources.action: Open the current season or calendar link from the homepage for dates, tickets, and venue details.

sources.name: CSU Extension Las Animas County Events
sources.public_use: Agriculture, 4-H, family, food, natural-resource, and community education programs.
sources.action: Check the county Extension calendar for current workshops, registrations, and program contacts.

sources.name: Spanish Peaks Country Events
sources.public_use: Festivals, arts, recreation, markets, performances, and visitor-facing events throughout Huerfano County.
sources.action: Use the event calendar to review current dates or follow its community event-submission route.

sources.name: Huerfano County Chamber - Submit an Event
sources.resource_type: Business and community event submission form
sources.public_use: Business, nonprofit, civic, arts, and public events serving Huerfano County.
sources.action: Use the chamber's current event form and provide complete organizer and event details.

sources.name: Huerfano County Government Events
sources.public_use: County meetings, public notices, civic dates, and Huerfano County government events.
sources.action: Use the county calendar for current public dates and links to the responsible office.

sources.name: La Veta Public Library Full Calendar
sources.public_use: Library programs plus selected community, arts, education, and public events around La Veta and Huerfano County.
sources.action: Check the full calendar for dates, locations, registration details, and organizer links.

sources.name: La Veta Creative District Festivals and Signature Events
sources.public_use: Festivals, exhibitions, performances, markets, and signature arts events in La Veta.
sources.action: Use the creative-district page for major arts dates and follow organizer links for current details.
